Complete REST API collection for the Corporate Food Ordering System.

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` (default `http://localhost:8081`)

**Seed data** (from `V1__init_schema.sql`):
| Resource | IDs / values |
|---|---|
| Companies | 1=گروه الین, 2=شرکت لمون, 3=شرکت الین, 4=شرکت شمس |
| Employees | 1=admin1 (ADMIN), 2=manager1 (MANAGER), 3=emp1 (EMPLOYEE) — password: `password` |
| Foods | 1–7 |
| Working week | 1 (week 4, year 1405) |
| Week days | 1=شنبه … 7=جمعه |
| Food order | 1 (employee 1, week 1, day 1, food 1) |

**Auth:** `app.security.enabled` defaults to `false` (no auth). When `true`, enable collection **Basic Auth** with `{{authUsername}}` / `{{authPassword}}`.

**Response envelope:** All endpoints return `ApiResponse<T>` with `success`, `message`, `data`, `timestamp`.
